question: Which mantra accompanies the presentation of the great lamp-waving?
premises: The great lamp-waving is to be presented.
The mantra 'na tatra sūryo bhāti' is specified.
inference: One should present the great lamp-waving with the mantra 'na tatra sūryo bhāti'.
plain_english: One should present the great lamp-waving with the mantra 'na tatra sūryo bhāti'.
